segments.title: New TradeOffer and Move models and build_offer, modified PokemonEntry and main

traceDiagram.title: Build trade offer flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `main()` of the `pokedex` command [reads a trainer file and builds a trade offer from it](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L12-13). It also shows what happens when a user runs `pokedex` with a trainer file and a wanted Pokemon as JSON, and how that input reaches the validators of `TradeOffer` through [`build_offer()`](code:src/pokedex/importer.py#L10-11).

traceNodes.label: Checks the name and the power of one move
traceNodes.description: When `build_offer()` validates a Pokemon as `PokemonEntry`, pydantic [validates each entry of `moves` as this model](code:src/pokedex/schemas.py#L17). No code of the repository calls the model by name.

blockLabels.label: Checks that the name has 1 to 30 characters
Checks that the power is from 0 to 250

traceNodes.label: Parses one Pokemon with its types, level and moves
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex` with a trainer file and a wanted Pokemon, [`build_offer()` validates the offered and the wanted Pokemon as this model](code:src/pokedex/importer.py#L11). `read_trainer()` also parses [every Pokemon of the team of a `Trainer`](code:src/pokedex/schemas.py#L31) as this model.

blockLabels.label: Parses at most 4 moves as `Move` models

traceNodes.label: Builds a trade offer from a trainer file and prints it
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex` with a trainer file and a wanted Pokemon as JSON, Python calls this function, because `[project.scripts]` of `pyproject.toml` names `pokedex.cli:main`.

blockLabels.label: Calls read_trainer to read the trainer from the file of the first argument
Calls build_offer to offer the first Pokemon for the one of the second argument
Raises a SystemExit when the trainer file or the offer is not valid

traceNodes.label: Validates both Pokemon and builds the trade offer
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex` with a trainer file and a wanted Pokemon, [`main()` calls this function](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L13). It gets the name of the trainer, the first Pokemon of the team and the parsed JSON of the second argument.

blockLabels.label: Returns the trade offer with both Pokemon validated
Calls TradeOffer to make the offer of the trainer

traceNodes.label: Parses a trade offer and runs its validators
traceNodes.description: When a user runs `pokedex` with a trainer file and a wanted Pokemon, `main()` calls `build_offer()`, and [`build_offer()` makes this model](code:src/pokedex/importer.py#L11). A failed validator raises `ValidationError`, and [`main()` prints that error](code:src/pokedex/cli.py#L14-16).

children.label: Removes the spaces around the trainer name
children.description: When `build_offer()` makes a `TradeOffer`, pydantic calls this method on the `trainer` field, because [`@field_validator("trainer")` names that field](code:src/pokedex/schemas.py#L39).

blockLabels.label: Returns the trainer name without the spaces around it

children.label: Raises ValueError when the levels differ by more than 10
children.description: When `build_offer()` makes a `TradeOffer`, pydantic calls this method after every field is valid, because [the method is a `model_validator` in the `after` mode](code:src/pokedex/schemas.py#L44).

blockLabels.label: Raises a ValueError when the levels differ by more than 10
Returns the trade offer as it is
